Name: Shi's Seasonal Cuter Picket Fence
Author: ShilohAreles
Description:
[center][color=#f4cccc]﻿﻿[img]https://imgur.com/vHe6mVS.png[/img]﻿﻿[/color]
[/center]
[center][font=Georgia]
[color=#f4cccc]This labor of [s]dread[/s] love is my first full fledge, all my own assets mod. I was looking for a fence that fit the niche of how I wanted to style my farm AND was its own unique item, and what was out there didn't fit that. However this was a huge undertaking compared to the modding I was used to (vanilla item retextures), so I will be taking a bit of a back seat from the planned releases or any further mods for at least a couple weeks. Fear not, I'll be here and on the SDV discord if there are any issues with the mod.[/color]

[color=#f4cccc][size=4]🪙 If you enjoy my mods, [url=https://ko-fi.com/shilohareles]please consider leaving me a tip [/url]﻿🪙[/size][/color]

[color=#f4cccc][img]https://imgur.com/pQAC8o3.png[/img][/color]

[color=#f4cccc]It includes:[/color][/font]
[color=#f4cccc]⚬[/color] [font=Georgia][color=#f4cccc]"compatibility" for ﻿the 5 most popular recolors, as well as vanilla.[/color][/font] 
[font=Georgia][color=#f4cccc]⚬ 3 tones to choose from; Gwen's, light and dark.[/color]
[color=#f4cccc]⚬ Seasonal variations; both seasonal decor, and seasonal color changes (except for vanilla).[/color]
[color=#f4cccc]⚬ No dynamic tokens to determine your used recolor if applicable; easily mix and match from any of the recolors if you like how it looks.[/color]

[b][color=#ea9999]In order to use the custom gates that come with this mod, you [u]MUST[/u] place the gates on the fence and not an empty space between fence pieces; doing so will result in the vanilla fence sprites.[/color][/b]

You will need: [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] [/b]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][b]SMAPI[/b][/url], as well as any of the optional recolors. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]GMCM[/b][/url] makes changing config options easier.

[color=#f4cccc]If you would like to add a translation or see any bugs or pixel errors on the tilesheet(s), please comment! 📝[/color]


[color=#f4cccc][img]https://imgur.com/zUORnCJ.png[/img][/color]

[color=#f4cccc]⚬ Install both Content Patcher and SMAPI and any optional files[/color]
[color=#f4cccc]⚬ Install this mod into your mods folder[/color]
[color=#f4cccc]⚬ Run the game once to generate the config file. You can edit this manually, but preferably use GMCM to avoid accidentally altering the files incorrectly.[/color]

[color=#f4cccc]Should uninstall cleanly without issue. [/color]


[img]https://imgur.com/LIfcr3B.png[/img]

[center][font=Georgia][color=#f4cccc]
⚬ Change map fences to match throughout the valley (maybe, on the back burner for now)
⚬ Fall seasonal decoration adjustments


[img]https://imgur.com/L1MX0ee.png[/img]

⚬ Vertically placed gates blend in VERY well, don't forget where you've placed them.
⚬ Earthy Recolor's light variation has the subtlest change in seasonal color. It's changing even if it's hard to tell!﻿


[img]https://imgur.com/C5Y08Ek.png[/img]

A huge huge HUGE thanks to everyone who helped me get this together and put up with all my questions, confusions and frustrations in the SDV discord mod making channel﻿. ❤ There were a lot of you. ❤
